sources.snippet: Overview Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct is a 1.23 billion parameter instruction-tuned language model developed by meta-llama that handles multilingual text generation for dialogue, retrieval, summarization, and agent-based tasks. Built as an auto-regressive transformer with Grouped-Query Attention (GQA), it uses a 128k token context window and processes input trained on up to 9 trillion tokens of ...

sources.snippet: Key model capabilities The Llama 3.2 instruction-tuned text only models are optimized for multilingual dialogue use cases, including agentic retrieval and summarization tasks. The models support assistant-like chat, agentic applications like knowledge retrieval and summarization, mobile AI powered writing assistants and query and prompt rewriting.
